decision: Wave41 rejects head-only replay adaptation: seed-0 replay current-buffer GAR normalized edit-distance improvement is -0.1666 versus -0.1639 for the information-matched teacher-state control, with identical zero invalid-action rate and 0.03125 loop rate. The active wave40 adaptive-GAR factorial is the higher-value test of candidate selection versus teacher mismatch, but both latent-teacher controls were process-invalid before training because their commands attempted to override a nonexistent objective.gar_action_value.teacher field. Recover only those two latent controls from the exact wave40 snapshot, unchanged except for removing that invalid override; the experiment configs already select latent_distance through data.gar_teacher. Compare random versus predicted-hard top-4 selection from 16 planning-matched prompt-plus-current proposals. Treat the two active exact-distance arms as explicitly terminal-privileged training diagnostics. Interpret the factorial only after all four cells are terminal. Advance hard selection only if it improves held-out broad-candidate GAR ranking and closed-loop normalized edit-distance improvement over random selection under the same teacher without worse collapse, invalid-action, or loop diagnostics. Advance exact-distance supervision only if it improves those same metrics over the matched latent arm; it remains an oracle-supervised training diagnostic, not an action-free claim.
